description: Keeps the workflows' action pins current (#326): each action stays pinned to a commit SHA, with its release as a trailing comment.
Also keeps the npm packages the `release` job runs with `npx -p name@x.y.z` current (#419), as one group so semantic-release and its plugins move together.
Only the github-actions and regex managers are enabled. Nothing else in this repository is updated by Renovate.
